reviews.author: Dat Gurl
reviews.text: Was traveling on 95 going to Charlotte from Savannah car decided to run hot and I had to pull off at a exit at a 711 was and called this guy based on close distance and reviews he quickly came to me !!! Was only like 10 min away wait ! told me he needed to take care to shop which was less then 10 min away he quickly came back with trailer for car he already had car part literally less then 20 min at his shop he had me back on the road now back in Charlotte no issues * would highly recommend to any woman traveling alone like I was (I’ve seen scary movies and don’t trust ppl like that driving into the country) a pure gentleman, courteous and respectful very knowledgeable * showed me the broken part and the one he put on, would use again if I’m over in the area, really a nice person thank you Derrick I appreciate you so so so much !!

reviews.author: Meeko Gibbs
reviews.text: *****DO NOT UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES RETAIN THIS MAN FOR ANY TYPE OF CAR REPAIR*****My transmission went out in South Carolina during a drive to Florida in December of 2025. Initially, Mr. Gadsden seemed like a nice guy. He advised me that he had found a transmission with 47,0000 miles on it with a 30-day warranty. He advised me that he would send me all the paperwork along with the warranty. I paid him 5000. Where everything went wrong is when I kept asking him for the receipt verbally and via text message and he never responded and never produced the receipt for the labor or the price of the transmission, even though he advised me several times that he would. I have no idea where this transmission came from or if it only had 47,000 miles. I suspect that the reason he is not producing the receipt is because it didn’t cost as much as he stated or had more miles on it than he stated. It is now April 2026, and he still has not produced any type of receipt and has not responded to my phone calls or messages. Several months later I had an issue with the undercarriage of my vehicle, and the mechanic asked me if I had any recent work done to the vehicle as he suspected the additional damage was a direct result of the work done on the transmission. This cost me an additional $800. This man got over on me after I trusted him to replace my transmission. I don’t want anyone else to lose money the way I did. Steer clear of this guy. He is NOT a nice guy. Ignore any 5-star review that he has as I suspect they may be fake.

reviews.author: carla Turner
reviews.text: This guy is amazing! I was passing through on a Sunday and lights started going off on my vehicle. I googled and went down the listing of mechanics near me. NOONE was available or wanted ridiculous fees to just come to me. This kind man came to me and attempted a quick fix. But unfortunately I needed more. He opened his shop back up and had me back on the road in no time!

reviews.author: becca luschen
reviews.text: My starter failed at a rest stop yesterday and I got my car towed to Gadsden’s late last night. Early this morning they called and had already ordered the new starter. As soon as they received it they promptly got it switched out and by 2pm same day I had my car returned to me and at an extremely reasonable price. Amazing service from the team, Jamel and Derrick. Thank you guys for saving the day!

reviews.author: Hailie Rice
reviews.text: I do not recommend them. I needed my car diagnosed & then fixed. Gadsden’s said they could diagnose it on a Monday. Never heard anything. Finally heard something on a Wednesday then after that he went MIA. My car was sitting at his shop but he would not answer anyone. Finally I had to get a tow truck to show up and take my car to someone else. Not sure what he was getting at with my car being there and him not answering a single phone call, text, or anyone I had try to call him.

reviews.author: Jessica Harley
reviews.text: Hands down the best in town! I can’t say enough good things about Gadsden’s Auto Service. From the moment I pulled in, I was greeted with professionalism, honesty, and a team that truly knows what they’re doing. The owner diagnosed my car quickly, explained everything clearly, and got me back on the road faster than I expected. If you’re looking for reliable, skilled, and trustworthy auto service, Gadsden’s is it. Support local and experience service the right way!

reviews.author: Rodrigo Amador
reviews.text: I was having issues with my “transmission service required” light coming on and off, one auto shop told me a needed a new transmission $5,200 worth or parts and labor, after talking to Jamell and him inspecting my vehicle I found out that my van didn’t need a new transmission but a new lead board inside the transmission, my advice is to always seek a second even a third opinion. My 3 hour drive from Charlotte NC was worth it, Thank you Gadsden’s Auto Service.

reviews.author: Warren Dent
reviews.text: Derrick answered the call on Saturday, had us off the side of the road within minutes, and replaced our blown radiator on a Sunday but charged us Monday to Friday (fair) prices. Do not hesitate to call this man. Thanks for saving our Edisto vacation!

reviews.author: Kevin White
reviews.text: More than a garage, They are your mechanic for life. Our Family vacation came to an abrupt halt when our car overheated on the interstate. We were far from home and 3pm on Saturday before Easter. Gadsdens offered to come pick me up but I limped over to their private garage. They troubleshooted the problem and we tag teamed calling parts stores to locate the hard to find part. No one would deliver the part due to the weekend. One was located an hour away, and we rode together to the store to get it. They coordinated the right mechanic for the job who was standing by at the garage. They welcomed me into their home with my 1 year old, and really made you feel like family. They worked into the night to fix the car and get us back on the road SAME DAY!!!! They easily saved us hundreds on hotel bills and went out of their way on a Saturday to help us. What more could you possibly ask for from a mechanic?!?! Good people. Thank you!

reviews.author: Lucinda Wingert
reviews.text: Gadsden’s Auto Service was a super big help! 5 stars because he helped me out immediately with my coolant leak, even though he seemed real busy with other things. He figured it out super quickly & took me to the parts store as well. I asked to watch and learn what he was repairing and how to and he showed me. He even called me up an hour or so later to check in and see if I was all good. I’d recommend this shop to anyone and would definitely go back! I also learned that he’s been working on cars since he was young and rebuilds transmissions! I came there with a 1999 7.3 power stroke diesel bus and he had me out in no time. I went because he said he has the same engine in his truck! He works well with you, reasonable price!

reviews.author: A&A Travel
reviews.text: We got stuck in Walterboro with transmission issues while traveling from Florida. Derrick picked up our truck from our hotel on a Saturday morning and had it completely fixed by the evening. He was very communicative and transparent. So thankful we found him. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Kenneth Williams
reviews.text: Was in need of a mechanic to do a variety of things to my vehicle, and I’m glad I chose this shop. Mr Gadsden was great, did everything I needed and was quick with getting me back riding. I definitely plan to chose this shop again.

reviews.author: Monique Green
reviews.text: I call on Wednesday and Derrick came and got my car he was friendly kept good communication with me figure the problem out and had my car fix by Friday and brought my car to me when he finish fixed it if anyone have any car issue I highly recommend Derrick for the job I am a real satisfied customer my car runs so good thanks a lot Derrick for the wonderful job!!!

reviews.author: Eliannis Carbonell
reviews.text: Quality and fast service!!we were broken down Sunday on interstate 95 with no hope and here we able to solve the problem and continue,thanks
